title: BizOps Manager
description:
About Foundation Health

Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

The Role

Foundation Health is building AI-native pharmacy infrastructure, used by health systems, consumer health brands and pharma manufacturers. We're ~70 people, Series A, and growing quickly across the UK and US — and the operational engine behind the product needs to grow just as fast.

That's where you come in. You'll be the right hand to our BizOps Director, working closely with our COO and with genuine visibility across senior leadership — the work you do here gets seen, used, and built on. You'll pick up the projects that don't fit neatly into any one team and run them from problem framing through to done, and you'll help shape the roadmap for what we take on next, not just deliver what's already on it.

This is a generalist role in the truest sense. We're not looking for someone who's done one thing deeply — we're looking for someone who's done lots of things well, and can pick up whatever comes next. You'll also be working with AI at a depth most companies can't offer: it's the core of what we build and how we work, not something bolted on. And as we scale, this role scales with you — the scope is genuinely yours to grow.

What You'll Be Doing

No two weeks here look the same. Day to day could involve any of the below — and that variety is a big part of what makes the role interesting:

  • Strategic projects — taking a loosely-framed problem, structuring it, doing the analysis, and driving it to implementation — while feeding into the roadmap for where we go next.

  • Procurement & vendor management — sourcing, negotiating with, and managing the tools and vendors that keep the company running — from helpdesk platforms to AI tooling.

  • Contracts & legal — supporting responses to RFIs, RFPs and bids from major US health systems, reviewing agreements, and getting comfortable in the commercial detail.

  • Pricing — understanding what our solutions cost to deliver and modelling what we should sell them at. We’ve built a tiered, usage-based pricing structure from the cost-of-goods up — you’ll help evolve it as the product grows.

  • Commercial & partnerships — supporting sales, client onboarding, and building the collateral and internal tools that help the commercial team move faster.

  • Cross-functional work — partnering with sales, engineering, CX, product, and design to get things over the line.

  • InfoSec & compliance — we operate in a HIPAA-regulated environment with a SOC 2 posture and an active certification programme. You’ll help run controls, policies and third-party risk assessments. You don’t need to be a security specialist, but you should bring a methodology and framework mindset.

Who We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in a technology, AI, data, or engineering-focused consulting environment. High-performing senior consultants ready to step up, and managers who want more scope than a big firm will give them, are exactly the sweet spot.

  • A genuinely broad project history. You’ve moved between delivery, business analysis, product, engineering-adjacent work, maybe bids and commercials — rather than specialising in a single service line.

  • High agency. You take a brief, lead it, and go further than asked — you don’t wait for instructions.

  • Someone who runs at a challenge, not around it. You’ll regularly be handed problems you’ve never seen before, and your first instinct is to jump in and figure them out.

  • Real, day-to-day AI adoption. Not just slides — we want to hear how you use AI to research, organise, and build, and what you’ve automated or made outside of work.

  • Comfort with pace and ambiguity. We’re a startup: priorities shift, and the role will grow with the company.

  • Sector agnostic — whether your projects were in banking, insurance, government, healthcare, or anything else. Experience in regulated industries helps; healthcare exposure is a plus, never a requirement.

Android Engineer - Engagement Mission
Field Marketing Manager
description:
About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

FLUX gets attention the moment people see it. Your job is to turn that attention into pipeline.

You'll own two motions where FLUX meets enterprises and partners in person: the events where customers experience the models firsthand, and the co-marketing engine with cloud and distribution partners who bring FLUX to the market. You’ll work directly with GTM, Partnerships, and our creative technologists. Our release cadence means there’s always a new reason to show up. Your job is to make sure we show up well and that every appearance has a number attached to it in order to effectively measure impact.

What you’ll work on

Events

  • Shape BFL's event calendar end-to-end: tier the opportunities, decide where we show up, and run the full events lifecycle: booths, demos, speaker slots, exec briefings, side events, follow up and more

  • Design event experiences that demonstrate the models, not just talk about them; working with Creative Technologists and FDEs on interactive demos and installations

  • Build the pre/post event machine: target lists for Sales, meeting orchestration on-site, pipeline attribution afterward. Every event has a number attached to measure impact (MQL’s)

  • Run BFL-hosted formats: customer dinners, launch events, and executive roundtables in key markets, plus side events at major moments (GTC, research oriented, etc.)

Co-marketing with partners

  • Own the co-marketing motion with our distribution and cloud partners; joint announcements, launch-day amplification, case studies, shared event presence

  • Coordinate partner marketing calendars around BFL launches so every major release lands with multiplied reach

  • Build repeatable co-marketing playbooks per partner tier, and negotiate marketing commitments into partnership conversations alongside the Partnerships team

GTM Enablement

  • Pitch decks

  • Solution marketing

Connecting the motions

  • Co-own the activation calendar with our social marketing team so events, partner moments, and social land together

  • Feed what you learn on the floor (what lands, the questions enterprises actually ask back into GTM and product marketing)

What We're Looking For

  • 3–6 years in field/event marketing, partner marketing, or integrated campaigns at a B2B tech company

  • You've run events end-to-end (from a 10-person exec dinner to a major conference presence) and can show the pipeline they produced

  • You've done co-marketing with large partners

  • You understand enterprise marketing: how buying committees work, what an exec briefing needs to accomplish, why attribution matters

  • 80%+ execution. You can build the run-of-show, brief the booth staff, etc.

  • Strong visual taste: our outputs are judged visually, and so are our activations

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, tight timelines, and launch weeks where everything happens at once

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience marketing generative AI, creative tooling, or developer-facing infrastructure

  • Existing relationships in the creative AI community

  • Experience working with cloud or platform partners on joint GTM

  • You've built an event or campaign that people in the industry still reference

  • Time spent working in the US, or in a role with significant US market ownership

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your location, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior FP&A Analyst (all genders)
description:
About us

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

Your Role

Do you want to move beyond traditional Excel modeling and define the future of data-driven finance operations?

Are you ready to be a key architect of the financial narrative for a high-growth SaaS business backed by world-class PE investors?

...then you are our perfect match!

Prepare for a steep learning curve and the opportunity to leave a lasting legacy by evolving our FP&A infrastructure for the next stage of scale. This is not a 'run the model and report back' role; we want someone who interrogates the numbers, surfaces the story behind them, and is willing to challenge assumptions at every level of the organisation.

Please note: This is a 12 month maternity cover.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Strategic Visibility: Build, maintain, and present meaningful dashboards and reports (e.g., Monthly Flash, Management Pack, Board Pack) that enable the Board, CFO, and Head of FP&A to monitor performance and take action.

  • Modernize the Stack: Support the migration of our FP&A tool/platform by defining requirements, mapping data flows, validating systems, and training stakeholders.

  • Architect Planning Frameworks: Implement end-to-end forecasting and budgeting templates and processes to enable efficient, accurate quarterly and annual planning cycles.

  • Define the Truth: Partner with the Data team to validate SaaS KPIs, ensuring a single version of truth across all business reporting.

  • Sales & Marketing Partnering: Support pipeline-to-forecast conversion modeling and commission tracking for Sales, while collaborating with Marketing to optimize segment profitability and ROI.

  • Operational Ownership: Manage and forecast global OPEX directly with department heads and support the Accounting team with month-end reviews and ad-hoc strategic business cases.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • The Foundation: Minimum 4+ years’ experience in FP&A, business finance, or a similar analytical role, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or subscription business.

  • The "Scar Tissue": Proven track record of building complex financial models and managing investor-grade reporting (Private Equity/PE experience is a significant plus).

  • The Builder: Experience with platform/tool migrations (FP&A or ERP systems) and a history of driving process improvements.

Skills

  • Technical Mastery: Highly proficient in Excel/G-Sheets; SQL experience is a plus.

  • AI & Automation: Proven track record of leveraging AI-driven tools and methodologies to streamline analytical workflows and optimize repetitive tasks.

  • SaaS Fluency: Deep understanding of SaaS economics and metrics (ARR, Churn, LTV/CAC).

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written English; German is a bonus but not required.

Mindset

  • The Interrogator: You don't just report numbers; you surface the story behind them and challenge assumptions at every level.

  • The Owner Mindset: You take full ownership of your workstreams and drive change in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

  • Bias to Action: You prefer a "shipped" automated solution over a "perfect" manual one.

  • Keep it Simple: You champion the value of simplicity, identifying process improvements and eliminating non-value-added tasks.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto

  • Best of Both Worlds: We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.

  • Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

 

🌍 Our Mission

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

 
 

🤔 About the Role

We are looking for a Sr. Content and Social Media Manager to own our social channels and be the creative engine behind our marketing campaigns. You are a storyteller first and an operator second: you can take an idea, shape it into something people actually want to watch and share, and make it show up consistently everywhere we publish.

This is a connective role. You will own the content calendar, plan and run campaigns end to end, keep a strong and consistent presence on social, and run our newsletter. You will be the glue across marketing, making sure a campaign lands as one coherent story across social, email, and beyond rather than a set of disconnected posts. As the team grows we will add editorial depth alongside you (long-form writing and podcast production), so you can stay focused on what you do best: social, storytelling, and campaigns that move.

 

What would you be doing?

  • Own Nivoda’s social media channels end to end, from strategy and calendar to publishing and community, with Instagram and our primary channels front and centre.

  • Be the main creative force behind our marketing campaigns: come up with the idea, shape the story, and make it show up consistently across every channel.

  • Own the content calendar and keep every channel in sync, so campaigns land as one coherent story rather than scattered posts.

  • Plan and run campaigns end to end: the brief, the timeline, the assets, the launch, and the follow-through.

  • Run "The Modern Jewellers Playbook", our newsletter. Own the cadence and the sends, and tie it into everything else we are publishing.

  • Turn our bigger content moments, like interviews, launches, and guides, into a steady stream of social-first content that travels.

  • Write social and short-form copy that sounds like a real person and makes independent jewellers stop scrolling.

  • Work with our designer and video partners to ship content that looks as good as it reads, and with our paid marketer to amplify what is working.

  • Be the connective tissue across marketing: link events, campaigns, and content so nothing happens in a silo.

  • Track what performs across channels and use it to sharpen the calendar. Double down on what lands, and drop what does not.

 

What do we need from you?

  • 4+ years running social and content for a brand, with real ownership of channels and campaigns rather than just scheduling posts.

  • You are a storyteller first. You know how to take an idea and make it land as a post, an email, a thread, or a reel.

  • A body of social and campaign work you are proud of, ideally including channels you grew yourself.

  • You can write. Quickly, well, and in a voice that sounds human rather than corporate.

  • Sharp project management. You can run a content calendar and several campaigns at once without dropping any threads.

  • Comfort working hands-on on a small team and building process where none exists.

  • Fluent with the tools of modern social and content work, and happy to lean on AI to move faster.

  • An instinct for what performs, and the discipline to let data settle the debates.

 

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of the jewelry industry

  • Experience marketing to small business owners, retailers, or a trade and craft audience.

  • Hands-on with short-form video: you can shoot and cut a reel yourself, or confidently direct someone who can.

  • Experience running an email or newsletter program.

  • Community-building experience, online or off.

 

Our culture and what we offer

We're a high-growth company in an exponential expansion phase. We move fast, operate with low hierarchy, and give people real ownership from day one. If you want to work somewhere you can genuinely shape things: not just maintain them: Nivoda is the place.

 

Our current benefits

  • 🕐 Flexible working hours and vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 📈 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 Chance to join during our exponential expansion phase

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you from applying: we hire for potential and mindset, not just a checklist.

Please submit your CV in English.

description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Java Backend Engineer to join our Engineering team in Berlin or remotely from Germany. In this role, you will design, build, and scale high-performance backend systems using modern Java technologies and cloud-native architectures.

You will work on complex systems where reliability, clean architecture, and strong engineering standards matter, helping Atolls build backend services that can support growth across markets and platforms.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior Java Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Java 17 or other recent versions (11+).
  • Build and evolve microservice-based and event-driven architectures
  • Develop APIs using GraphQL
  • Work with Spring Boot and Spring Reactive (WebFlux)
  • Design and optimize data models using MySQL and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB or MongoDB)
  • Ensure high performance, reliability, and scalability of backend systems
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Implement performance testing and end-to-end testing
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, frontend engineers, and DevOps
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical best practices
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership when needed
  • Collaborate on AI-enabled features, including prompt engineering and backend integrations

 Your Profile:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in backend development

title: Principal IAM Consultant, Identity Governance and Data Access
description:
Intelance is building a trusted associate team for senior identity and data access work. We are looking for a Principal IAM Consultant to act as the design authority on complex client engagements. You will turn business access needs, system evidence and security requirements into a clear access model that teams can implement and operate.

Tasks

Your work will include:

• Leading the design of identity governance and data access models across Microsoft and business platforms.

• Challenging discovery findings before they are presented to senior client stakeholders.

• Mapping who should see and change client, fund and confidential business information.

• Designing access rules for joiners, role changes and leavers.

• Defining roles, groups, approval routes, access reviews and controlled exceptions.

• Reviewing service accounts, integrations and delegated access.

• Connecting Microsoft Entra, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, data platforms and business applications into one workable design.

• Turning the design into clear implementation steps, dependencies and evidence of completion.

• Working directly with technology, security, data and business leaders.

• Providing proportionate assurance during pilot and delivery work.

The first assignment is expected to be a small number of paid review days. Further work will depend on client approval and funded delivery.

Requirements

Essential:

• Strong recent experience designing identity governance and access models in complex organisations.

• Deep hands on knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.

• Practical experience of joiner, role change and leaver processes.

• Experience designing role based access, access reviews, privileged access and exception controls.

• Experience governing service accounts and access used by integrations.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and SharePoint permissions.

• Experience connecting business access decisions to technical groups, roles and permissions.

• Able to challenge evidence and explain risks and design choices in plain English.

• Comfortable working with senior client stakeholders and taking ownership of design quality.

• Based in the United Kingdom and able to work during UK business hours.

• Available for short assignments with the potential to support later delivery.

Strong advantage:

• Experience with Snowflake or other modern data platforms.

• Experience with AI tools or connectors that can reach company information.

• Experience in financial services, investment management or another regulated business.

• Experience supporting an access redesign or implementation across several connected systems.

Please apply only if you have personally designed and defended an access model. Product administration alone is not enough.

Benefits

• £650 to £850 per day, depending on the depth of experience and the assignment.

• Fully remote work within the United Kingdom.

• Focused assignments with clear outcomes and direct access to the engagement lead.

• Work with senior client teams on access problems that matter.

• Further paid work when a client approves the next delivery phase.

• Clear scope, agreed days and prompt payment.

Please submit your CV and answer the application questions clearly. We will first review your fit for the design authority role. Suitable candidates will then have a short screening call and a structured technical discussion based on a real access design scenario. We will be direct about scope, dates and the likely number of days before any assignment is agreed.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Foundations team, the backend backbone that builds the reliable, scalable, fast systems everyone else at Encord builds on top of. The team's core challenges sit deep in distributed and data-intensive systems.

The product mindset on this team is different from most of the company: short-term product insight matters less, long-term matters a lot. Foundations plans around how the next 6, 12, and 24 months will look, with an overarching shape to the problem: handling multiple orders of magnitude the data we handle today.

Encord is growing rapidly, with our product as the key driver of that growth. A year ago, we were a team of 100; now, we're over 150 and continuing to accelerate. The systems that got us here won't get us to what's next. That's the problem you'll help solve.

What you'll do

  • Take end-to-end ownership of significant projects within our database and processing systems, from design and architectural decisions all the way to deployment, monitoring, and measuring impact

  • Build robust distributed systems and reason carefully about how they fail and how they behave under load

  • Contribute to performant protocols and APIs, such as our label-format API, that customers use directly

  • Tackle complex domains and immense scale with simple solutions

  • Raise the bar through code reviews, pairing, and helping engineers around you do their best work

Who we're looking for

  • You've seen and built a lot. You have personally developed and maintained multiple systems from scratch, and you know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed

  • You want your work to have a tangible outcome for people. You're not satisfied with building products that do not see the light of day

  • You are a builder. You enjoy all aspects of building not only software but a complete product, and are comfortable moving across the stack when necessary

  • You enjoy problem-solving and thinking from first principles, reach for the simplest solution that works, and know when boring technology wins

  • You're happy to tackle problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go

  • You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you

Experience requirements

  • 5+ years building large-scale backend infrastructure applications

  • Deep fluency in at least one high-level language (we use Python and TypeScript, but we care more about depth than the specific language)

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching) and how they behave under load

  • Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout, and monitoring

  • Experience with data migrations or re-architecture projects is a plus

Tech stack

We are technology-agnostic at Encord and are not looking for experience across all of these. As long as you're open to learning, please apply.

  • Backend: Python

  • Frontend: TypeScript and React

  • Deployment: Kubernetes

  • Infrastructure: GCP

  • Machine learning: PyTorch, CUDA, Ray

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture: the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Company lunches twice a week

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time.

Key responsibilities:

  • Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand.

  • Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools.

  • Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration).

  • Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself.

  • Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating.

  • Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling.

Your background:

  • A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work.

  • Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration.

  • A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet.

  • A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop.

  • You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human).

  • You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners).

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We’re called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group’s mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. title: Senior Manager, Customer Success
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Success to lead our UKI team within the Large and High Growth segment. Joining our Customer Experience department, you will be responsible for executing our regional CS strategy, driving team performance, and ensuring an exceptional experience for our most strategic UKI customers.

In this role, you will directly manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Your mission is to operationalise our customer success motions, ensuring your team successfully drives product adoption, value realisation, retention, and expansion across their portfolios.

This role is ideal for an experienced B2B SaaS or Fintech people leader who thrives in fast-paced environments. You should bring a strong execution discipline, a commercial mindset, and a passion for frontline coaching to help your team turn complex customer challenges into simple, impactful solutions.

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director, Customer Success (large and high growth) and leading a dedicated regional team of CSMs. The team is highly collaborative and dedicated to retain the largest customers of Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to work closely with UKI commercial team, account managers, customer support, onboarding, product and RevOps to ensure customer risk is addressed early and growth opportunities are maximised

 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Manager of Customer Success, you will:

  • Lead and coach a team of 10 CSMs, providing active coaching, career development, and daily operational guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality performance.

  • Own your team’s core metrics.

  • Implement and iterate on segment-specific success plans, engagement motions, renewal readiness playbooks, and risk-mitigation strategies.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure seamless customer transitions, aligned account strategies, and coordinated execution during renewals and expansion plays.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for UKI strategic accounts, working cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Operations to eliminate friction points.

  • Use operational insights, data dashboards, and forecasting metrics to track team productivity, evaluate portfolio health, and proactively address churn risks.

Immediate priorities you can expect to tackle:

  • Strengthening localised account health visibility and proactive risk intervention.

  • Building high-impact execution habits across your team of 10 CSMs.

  • Improving renewal readiness and commercial handoffs with the UKI Sales teams.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and performance excellence.

 

What You Bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, with a proven track record of 2+ years directly managing high-performing teams in B2B SaaS, fintech, or fast-paced technology environments.

  • Strong experience supporting large, mid-market, or enterprise-level accounts with complex stakeholders and sophisticated commercial needs.

  • A strong commercial acumen - you seamlessly connect day-to-day customer health to retention, expansion, and long-term business value.

  • Deep familiarity with Customer Success methodologies, customer lifecycles, health scoring, and risk mitigation tools.

  • Excellent people leadership skills with a proven ability to hire, inspire, hold accountable, and develop talent.

  • A data-driven approach, comfortable utilising CRM and CS tooling (e.g.Hubspot, Vitally) to drive team performance and forecasting.

  • Fluency in English with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Other languages are a plus

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience in fintech, spend management, payments, or financial operations verticals.

  • Experience scaling team structures from smaller cohorts to larger regional pods.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love combining frontline coaching with commercial strategy

  • You thrive in high-velocity, evolving environment

  • You want to make a highly visible, regional impact

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer a steady, predictable corporate routine

  • You want to step away from the frontline

  • You view Customer Success as purely “customer happiness"

 

How You’ll Develop in this Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Establish a highly cohesive, high-performing UKI CS team structure for our CSMs.

  • Deliver measurable improvements in UKI customer retention, renewal execution, and expansion pipelines.

  • Build a deep understanding of our product ecosystem to successfully advocate for the needs of our UKI market.

  • Be recognized as a vital execution partner to our Director of CS and a champion for our large and high-growth customer base.

 

Location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins interview with the hiring manager to deep dive into your experience and what you can bring to the team

  3. Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take-home test to showcase your onboarding strategy and data driven approach and invite you to a 60 mins team interview to present your challenge and to know part of the team

  4. Final Interview: Final conversation with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Manager, Customer Success, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Highlight the most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce)
description:
Deine Mission

Alle reden über AI. Wir entscheiden, wie sie im Unternehmen wirklich eingesetzt wird.
Ein 400-Milliarden-Dollar-Markt. Ein profitables Scale-up, das ihn mit AI und einem globalen Freelancer-Netzwerk neu denkt. Und mittendrin ein Team, das nicht primär Code schreibt, sondern entscheidet, was AI im Unternehmen bewirken soll - für mehr als 25.000 Talents in über 70 Ländern, durch Automatisierung und intelligente Prozesse.

Wir suchen dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce) in unserem Headquarter in München-Schwabing für unsere cross-funktionale strategische Taskforce. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Strategy, Business und AI - als Sparringspartner:in für AI Engineers, Product- und Operations-Expert:innen sowie eine ehemalige BCG-Beraterin. Nicht als zusätzliche:r Engineer im Team, sondern als die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das Team das Richtige baut.
Das ist keine klassische Werkstudentenstelle für Techies. Du strukturierst Probleme, baust Business Cases, bewertest AI-Anwendungen aus Business-Perspektive und übersetzt zwischen dem, was technisch möglich ist, und dem, was strategisch sinnvoll ist. Die Konzepte, an denen du arbeitest, landen nicht in einer Schublade - sie fließen direkt in Entscheidungen unseres Leadership-Teams ein.

Was du wirklich machst

  • AI-Strategie statt AI-Code: Du arbeitest an strategischen AI-Initiativen wie unserem Talent Assistant oder AutoQA 2.0 (KI-basierte Voice-File-Analyse) mit - nicht als Entwickler:in, sondern als jemand, der Anforderungen strukturiert, Prioritäten setzt und aus ersten Ideen belastbare Feature-Konzepte macht. Die technische Umsetzung übernehmen unsere AI Engineers; du sorgst dafür, dass sie das Richtige bauen.
  • Aus Ideen werden Entscheidungen: Du analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, baust Business Cases nach klassischer Case-Logik auf und entwickelst Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Leadership-Team. Deine Analysen beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche AI-Initiativen umgesetzt werden.
  • AI braucht Struktur: Große Sprachmodelle sind nur so gut wie die Daten dahinter. Du definierst Kompetenzframeworks und Bewertungslogiken, die unsere AI-Systeme intelligenter machen - die inhaltliche Logik, nicht die technische Implementierung.
  • Eigene Projekte mit echtem Ownership: Du übernimmst eigenständig Themen von der ersten Analyse bis zum ersten Konzept - ein neuer AI-Use-Case, ein Workflow, der heute noch manuell läuft, eine Automatisierung, ein neuer Lösungsansatz. Der Inhalt wechselt, der Anspruch nicht: Du bekommst Verantwortung, nicht nur Aufgaben.
  • Dort arbeiten, wo gerade der größte Hebel liegt: Du unterstützt unser Team dort, wo aktuell die spannendsten strategischen Fragestellungen entstehen. Das bedeutet Abwechslung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und sichtbaren Impact.
Warum diese Rolle dich außergewöhnlich schnell wachsen lässt

Hier lernst du nicht programmieren - du lernst, wie man AI-Investitionen bewertet, Business Cases baut, die vor Geschäftsführung und Leadership bestehen, und komplexe Themen so strukturiert, dass daraus messbarer Business Impact entsteht. Volle technische Verantwortung für Rocket — direkt an die Gründer, ohne Zwischenebene

tack von Marriott. Unsere Engineers arbeiten also mitten im echten Hotelbetrieb, nicht gegen Sandbox-APIs.

Du führst das Engineering-Team inklusive unserer AI-/Data-Funktion, verantwortest die Schnittstelle zu Product und stehst für alles gerade, was ausgeliefert wird.


  • Engineering, end-to-end. Architektur, System-Design, Delivery gegen die Roadmap, Zuverlässigkeit, technische Schuld. Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA und das AI-/Data-Team laufen bei dir zusammen. Du setzt schlanke Prozesse, mit denen ein kleines Team schnell liefert, ohne Dinge zu zerbrechen.
  • Eine AI-gestützte Engineering-Pipeline. Wir bauen nicht nur AI-Produkte — wir bauen mit AI. Du machst die Engineering-Organisation selbst AI-nativ: agentische Coding-Workflows, AI-gestützte Reviews und Tests, Automatisierung von allem Wiederkehrenden. Ein kleines Team soll liefern wie ein dreimal so großes — das wahr zu machen ist dein Job.
  • AI als Kernfähigkeit des Systems. Du architektierst die Integration von LLMs und agentischen Workflows in Produktivsysteme: deterministische Logik kombiniert mit AI-generierten Ergebnissen, mit echter Validierung, Fallbacks und Zuverlässigkeitsstrategien. Der Hotelbetrieb läuft auf unserer Plattform — Nicht-Determinismus ist keine Entschuldigung für Unzuverlässigkeit.
  • Das Team. Einstellen, entwickeln, skalieren. Du übernimmst ein starkes kleines Team und machst daraus eine leistungsstarke Engineering-Organisation mit einer Kultur aus Ownership und Tempo. Auch unsere verteilte Hiring-Strategie über mehrere Standorte hinweg liegt bei dir.
  • Product- und Business-Alignment. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und Product. Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, vereinfachst Komplexität und verbindest Engineering-Arbeit mit Ergebnissen: Umsatz, Automatisierung, Kundenwirkung. Mit dem US-Markteintritt muss Engineering mit Enterprise-Kunden auf zwei Kontinenten Schritt halten.

Woran wir Erfolg messen:

  • 6 Monate: Delivery ist planbar, die AI-gestützte Dev-Pipeline läuft, und das Team ist um A-Player gewachsen, die du eingestellt hast.
  • 12 Monate: Die Plattform skaliert mit US-Enterprise-Kunden, die Kernsysteme sind zuverlässig und observierbar, und Engineering ist ein Wettbewerbsvorteil — kein Flaschenhals.

Ehrlich gesagt: Das ist volle Verantwortung ohne Netz darüber. Keine CTO-Ebene, die Entscheidungen abnimmt oder abfängt — die Architektur, das Team und alles, was ausgeliefert wird, sind deins. Wenn du eine Rolle suchst, in der jemand über dir die Richtung vorgibt, ist das nicht deine Stelle. Wenn du genau diese Verantwortung willst, ist es die richtige.


Dein Profil

  • 10+ Jahre Software Engineering, davon 5+ in einer Engineering-Führungsrolle in wachstumsstarken Produktunternehmen.
  • Starker Hands-on-Hintergrund in Backend oder Full-Stack — du kannst noch selbst in die Tiefe gehen.
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung, Engineering-Teams in wachsenden Startups zu skalieren.
  • Starke Architektur-Expertise: APIs, verteilte Systeme, Event-Driven Design, Cloud.
  • LLM-/agentische AI-Systeme in Produktion — und eine echte Überzeugung, dass Engineering selbst AI-gestützt gehört.
  • Product-Mindset: Du verbindest technische Entscheidungen mit geschäftlichen Ergebnissen.
  • Souverän im Umgang mit Ambiguität, Tempo und voller Verantwortung.

Ein Pluspunkt, kein Muss: Hintergrund in Hospitality-Tech, CRM, PMS oder Revenue Management. Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integrationen (Salesforce, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Microsoft Graph API). Erfahrung in der Führung verteilter, internationaler Teams.


Warum wir?

Wir sind das Technologieunternehmen, das den Gruppen- und Veranstaltungsverkauf in der Hotellerie neu denkt. Was heute über Posteingang, Excel und Telefon läuft, macht unsere Plattform Rocket zu einem durchgängigen, KI-gestützten Prozess — von der ersten Anfrage bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Europäische Hotelgruppen führen ihren Gruppenverkauf bereits darüber.
Das bedeutet für dich: Du arbeitest nicht trotz KI, sondern mit ihr. Wer bei uns anfängt, gibt Feedback, das in Produktentscheidungen einfließt — und versteht irgendwann, warum ein Prompt besser funktioniert als ein anderer.
Und weil wir schnell wachsen, ist vieles bei uns noch im Entstehen. Manche Antwort lautet ehrlicherweise „das bauen wir gerade noch”. Genau darin liegt die Chance: Du triffst auf Freiräume statt auf fertige Strukturen, und was du hier aufbaust, trägt deine Handschrift.

title: Fullstack Developer – AI & LLM (m/w/d)

Was heute Menschen leisten – erkennen, wo ein Kind hängt, im richtigen Moment nachfragen, die passende Übung anbieten – soll künftig ein LLM-basiertes System unterstützen. Nicht als Chatbot mit Bildungsanstrich, sondern als proaktiver Lernbegleiter, der den Lernstand versteht, kindgerecht kommuniziert und an eine echte Pädagogik angebunden ist.

Das Ganze läuft als dreijähriges Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekt, gefördert durch die Investitionsbank Berlin im Programm ProFIT Berlin. Deine Mission

Du entwirfst und baust die LLM-Architektur hinter dem Lernbegleiter für cleverly und complori: Retrieval über kindbezogene Lernprofile und Kursinhalte, proaktive Kommunikationsauslösung und die Echtzeit-Generierung von Mikrolerninhalten. • Kontext-Pipeline bauen – Aufbereitung und Vektorisierung heterogener Daten (Kursmaterialien, Interaktionsdaten, Coach-Feedback, Konversationsverläufe) in Postgres/pgvector

• Evaluation und Qualitätssicherung – Eval-Frameworks für Groundedness, kindgerechte Sprache und pädagogische Angemessenheit, inklusive Guardrails und Eskalationswegen zu menschlichen Coaches

• Datenschutz by Design – DSGVO-konforme Verarbeitung sensibler Daten von Minderjährigen, Auswahl und Betrieb von Modellen auf EU-Infrastruktur bzw. in deutschen Rechenzentren

• Produktintegration – Anbindung der KI-Komponenten an unsere bestehende Plattform über REST-APIs, gemeinsam mit dem Entwicklungsteam

• Technologieevaluation – strukturierte Bewertung von Modellen und Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, DSPy). Wir setzen auf moderne, bewährte Werkzeuge statt auf das Fine-Tuning von Basismodellen.

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• 3–5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit Python, nodejs oder C#

• Produktionserfahrung mit LLM-Anwendungen – RAG-Pipelines (Embedding-Auswahl, Chunking, Hybrid Search, Re-Ranking), Agenten-Orchestrierung und/oder Prompt- und Pipeline-Optimierung

• Erfahrung mit LLM-Evaluation – Offline-Eval-Sets, Metriken für Faktentreue und Relevanz, Guardrails. Das ist für uns das wichtigste Einzelkriterium: Wir brauchen jemanden, der belegen kann, dass das System besser wird, statt es nur zu behaupten.

• Solide Kenntnisse in SQL und relationalen Datenbanken; Erfahrung mit Vektordatenbanken (idealerweise pgvector) und mit nicht-relationalen Datenbanken

• Strukturierte, dokumentierte Arbeitsweise und Lust auf ein kleines Team mit hohem Anspruch

• Sehr gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse – ein großer Teil unserer Inhalte und der Zusammenarbeit ist deutschsprachig

• Ein Herz für unsere Vision und Mission – Begeisterung für das Thema Bildung von Kindern/Heranwachsenden

Nice to have

• Erfahrung mit selbst gehosteter Modellinferenz (z. B. vLLM, TGI) und Linux-Server-Administration

• Grundverständnis von Node.js oder C#/.NET, um Integrationsstellen mitzudenken

• Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Anforderungen, insbesondere DSGVO und Verarbeitung von Kinderdaten

• Affinität zu Bildung und EdTech – oder schlicht eigene Kinder, die dir zeigen, wie Lernen wirklich funktioniert

title: Product Engineer — Working Student
description:
Working Student - Product Engineer

Over 4 million merchants use our card readers to process payments in 34 countries. As we build a world where every business can thrive, we continually expand our range of products and services. We are a truly global fintech company, with 3,000+ people from 93 nationalities spread across 22 offices on four continents.

As the People Tech team, our mission is to enable long-term scalability by fostering a data-informed culture through seamless systems and a people-centric employee experience. As our Product Engineer - Working Student, your first mission will be to help us rethink Feedback and Team Reviews: learn how the process works today, find the friction and turn promising ideas into product experiences that colleagues can test.

The work starts frontend-first: build realistic prototypes in React, Next.js or similar and explore a simpler product layer over Workday, our system of record. If a direction proves valuable, you may help grow it into a standalone internal app - from interface and APIs to data models, authentication and integrations - alongside People Tech and engineering partners.

This is a real product challenge, not a side quest: you will learn across discovery, UX, frontend, testing and product decisions, supported by mentorship and code review. You will collaborate with Product Owners, process owners, people tech and workday specialists, sumuppers, managers, people partners, people analytics and senior stakeholders, with potential exposure to backend development, integrations and production delivery. If your favourite way to answer "what if?" is to build it, you will fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Find the right problem: Speak with process owners, employees and managers to understand Feedback and Team Reviews, identify friction and decide what is worth solving first.
  • Shape a focused product slice: Turn requirements, questions and constraints into clear user journeys and an MVP that can teach us something useful.
  • Prototype and iterate quickly: Build realistic frontend experiences in React, Next.js or similar; compare directions, test assumptions and adjust when the evidence points somewhere better.
  • Design for different kinds of work:  Create accessible, intuitive flows for office-based teams, metrics-driven Field Sales colleagues and on-site teams without building three separate products.
  • Think end to end:  If the concept is validated, help evolve it towards a standalone app while considering APIs, data, authentication, privacy, deployment, integrations and what should remain in Workday.
  • Use AI as a co-pilot, not an alibi:  Use tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, v0, Lovable or similar to accelerate development while still understanding, checking and owning the result.
  • Make the learning visible: Demo your work, explain decisions and trade-offs, respond to feedback and document the findings and technical choices that should shape the next version.

You'll be great for this role if

  • Student status. You are currently enrolled at a university and available for a part-time role based in Berlin.
  • Modern web development skills. You have built web applications with React, Next.js or a similar frontend framework. Coursework, internships, hackathons, personal projects and portfolio work all count.
  • Product-minded builder. You care about the user's goal and accessibility, and can turn an ambiguous problem into the simplest useful solution, test it and iterate.
  • Full-stack and AI curiosity. You want to learn how APIs, data and services turn an interface into a reliable product, and can use AI-assisted tools while still understanding, checking and owning the result.
  • Clear, team-first communication. You can explain what you built end to end, make technical choices understandable, ask for input and respond well to feedback.

Nice to have

  • Backend and integration foundations. Some experience with Node.js, TypeScript, Python, databases, APIs, serverless functions, Supabase, Firebase, AWS or comparable technologies.
  • Identity and data concepts. A basic understanding of OAuth, SSO, permissions or responsible data handling.
  • What we don't expect: years of professional experience, previous Workday knowledge or a perfect first attempt. If you do not tick every box, please apply anyway and show us what you can build, how you think and how you learn.

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

Qualifikationen

title: Robot Pilot
description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.

Role Description:

Tier 2 Robot Pilots are trusted, high-output robot teleoperators who reliably collect high-quality

manipulation data using VR teleoperation systems. Pilots operate with minimal supervision,

consistently meet data throughput and quality standards, and can troubleshoot routine issues

(such as basic software workflow and lab operating issues). They also support researchers with

executing evaluation protocols and providing clear feedback on robot and model behavior.

 

Primary Duties

● Collect high-quality robot training data by teleoperating robotic systems using VR

equipment and hand controllers; demonstrate manipulation tasks repeatedly and

consistently.

● Meet daily performance expectations for data collection throughput, quality, and

consistency (including correct task setup and complete metadata/notes).

● Follow task specifications and SOPs precisely, maintain discipline around experiment

changes and “what changed” between sessions.

● Maintain a safe work environment and adhere to lab safety procedures at all times.

● Support evaluations by running structured evaluation protocols alongside researchers

and accurately reporting results and issues.

 

Additional Tasks:

● Troubleshoot and report issues with robot hardware/software and teleop tooling, capture

relevant logs/notes and escalate with clear reproduction steps.

● Perform basic operational maintenance per SOP (workspace reset between sessions,

calibration checks, battery swaps or component swaps as required).

● Review/annotate recordings as needed (lightweight review for quality checks, labeling

support, or spot audits).

● Participate in process improvements to increase data collection efficiency, reduce

downtime, and improve data quality.

● Occasional travel to customer/partner sites (domestic & international) to support on-site

robot data collection, including operating in new environments, coordinating with site

contacts, and following site-specific safety and security requirements.

● Occasional weekend overtime data collection (maximum one day per weekend),

balanced with flexible scheduling and time off during the week.

Required Qualifications:

● Strong VR / controller proficiency (VR gaming or similar real-time control experience).

● Ability to maintain focus while operating in VR for extended periods and follow detailed

written/video instructions.

● Comfort working hands-on with robotics equipment in a lab environment; safety-minded

and detail-oriented.

● Comfortable with Linux / command line (running programs with arguments, checking

logs).

● Ability to debug routine issues and distinguish between environment/setup vs software

vs hardware problems.

● Ability to write detailed bug reports when issues arise, document failure modes and

participate in investigative efforts to diagnose and recover quickly.

● Reliable attendance and punctuality; able to work a fixed full-time shift (AM or PM).

● Basic technical literacy: comfortable navigating computer tools, documenting work, and

communicating clearly.

● Able to stand/sit for extended periods, perform repetitive motions, and support physical

reset tasks as needed (may include lifting/moving items up to ~30 lbs, squatting/standing

during resets).

 

Preferred:

● Experience with robotics systems, lab work, automation, manufacturing/assembly, or

other precision technical work.

● Experience supporting structured experiments/evaluations with researchers or

engineers.

● Experience collecting teleop demonstration data (robots, simulators, or other real-time

control systems).

title: Sales Development Representative (m/f/d)
description:
YOUR JOB

Want to do more than just book meetings?

We're looking for ambitious Sales Development Representatives who are part of building DataGuard's outbound and pipeline generation motion from the ground up.

As one of our first dedicated SDRs, you'll work closely with Account Executives, Marketing and Revenue Operations to create new business opportunities through a combination of strategic outbound prospecting, account-based engagement and marketing-generated opportunities. You'll have the chance to influence how we approach pipeline generation, test new ideas, and help shape a scalable sales development function.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Generate qualified pipeline through outbound prospecting, inbound lead follow-up, account-based engagement and creative prospecting strategies.

  • Research target accounts, identify buying signals and create meaningful conversations with decision-makers.

  • Help shape and continuously improve DataGuard's sales development motion, messaging and prospecting approaches.

  • Qualify opportunities and work closely with Account Executives to ensure high-quality handovers.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Revenue Operations and Sales Leadership to improve pipeline generation and conversion.

  • Use modern sales technology, AI-powered tools and data-driven insights to work effectively and continuously improve performance.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world.

  • Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs.

  • Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market.

  • Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget.

  • Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • Initial experience in a SDR, BDR, Sales Development, Inside Sales or similar customer-facing commercial role.

  • Confidence engaging with prospects and building meaningful business conversations.

  • Curiosity, coachability and a genuine interest in SaaS, technology and modern sales.

  • A structured, proactive working style with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Resilience, ambition and a desire to continuously develop your commercial skill set.

  • Excitement about helping build something new rather than simply following an established playbook.

  • Strong communication skills in both German and English.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS:

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

title: Machine Learning Scientist
description:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is looking for a Machine Learning Scientist to deepen our ML research capabilities in clinical oncology. This is a senior, research-oriented role for someone who wants to develop novel approaches to medical image analysis, treatment outcome prediction, and multi-modal clinical data integration - and see those methods reach real clinical settings.

You’ll work at the intersection of ML research and clinical application, collaborating closely with physicians, medical physicists, and experienced engineers with deep domain expertise. Together, you’ll develop methods that are scientifically rigorous and clinically meaningful. Your work will directly shape our product capabilities and contribute to peer-reviewed science.

What You’ll Do

Research & Method Development

  • Develop novel ML/DL methods for medical image analysis, including segmentation, lesion detection, longitudinal tracking, treatment response prediction, and outcome modeling

  • Design and conduct experiments to evaluate new approaches against clinical baselines and state-of-the-art methods

Clinical Translation

  • Collaborate with clinicians and medical physicists to ensure methods are grounded in clinical reality

  • Produce validated research outputs with documented performance benchmarks and clear handoff specifications for production engineering

  • Contribute to clinical validation studies and evidence generation for regulatory submissions

External Engagement

  • Collaborate with external academic research partners on joint studies

  • Support scientific diligence with pharma and clinical partners

  • Contribute to Nucs AI's scientific credibility in the field


What You Bring

  • PhD in machine learning, computer vision, medical image analysis, biomedical engineering, or related field

  • Strong publication record in relevant venues (medical imaging, clinical ML, computer vision)

  • Experience structuring and executing research collaborations with academic and clinical institutions

  • Deep expertise in deep learning architectures for image analysis (CNNs, transformers, U-Nets, etc.)

  • Strong programming skills in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred)

  • Experience working with medical imaging data (PET/CT, MRI, or similar modalities)

  • Strong statistical foundations - experimental design, hypothesis testing, survival analysis, and clinical biostatistics

Bonus Points

  • Experience with nuclear medicine imaging & dosimetry (PSMA-PET, FDG-PET, SPECT)

  • Expertise in treatment outcome prediction, survival analysis, or longitudinal modeling

  • Experience with multi-modal data integration (imaging + clinical + genomic)

  • Familiarity with clinical trial design and regulatory evidence requirements

  • Prior industry experience translating research into deployed products

  • Experience with graph neural networks, molecular representations, or drug-response modeling

  • Experience with Generative AI in medical domain

Why Nucs AI

  • World-class collaborators  – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.

  • Massive market tailwinds  – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.

title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
description:
Einleitung

At Impower GmbH, we are shaping the future of property management — simple, fast, and digital. More than 100,000 people manage over 12 million apartments using processes that are still largely manual, complex, and time-consuming. We are changing that with modern technology, clear workflows, and real practical value.


Our Cloud ERP brings complex processes such as accounting, banking, and property management into one intuitive platform. As our product continues to grow, great design plays a key role in turning this complexity into simple and efficient user experiences.


As a Senior Product Designer, you take ownership of key areas of our core product and shape experiences that property managers rely on every day. Working closely with our Head of Design, Product Owners, and Engineers, you turn complex workflows into intuitive solutions and drive design topics hands-on from the initial problem to the shipped feature.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Own and drive product design across key areas of our core platform, from problem discovery to final implementation
  • Translate complex, data-heavy workflows into simple, intuitive, and scalable user experiences
  • Develop user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-quality UI designs that clearly communicate your solutions
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to turn concepts into technically feasible, shippable features
  • Contribute to and continuously improve our design system, including reusable components, patterns, and documentation
  • Use customer insights, product context, and feedback to challenge assumptions and continuously improve existing experiences
  • Support other designers by sharing expertise, providing feedback, and helping strengthen design quality across the team


Dein Profil

  • You bring 7–9 years of hands-on Product Design experience, ideally with SaaS products
  • You have experience designing complex, data-heavy products such as ERP systems, business software, or comparable applications
  • You combine strong UX thinking with excellent UI skills and experience working with scalable design systems
  • You are highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using modern AI and prototyping tools to accelerate your design process
  • You understand front-end development constraints and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers to bring designs into production
  • You take ownership of complex problems and confidently drive them from initial exploration through to a high-quality solution
  • You communicate confidently in both German and English and enjoy working in an international, cross-functional environment


Warum wir?

  • Meaningful impact: Shape a core product that helps thousands of people simplify complex property management processes every day
  • Real ownership: Take responsibility for important product areas and influence how our platform evolves
  • Close collaboration: Work directly with our Head of Design, Product, and Engineering in a highly cross-functional environment
  • Growth opportunities: Develop your expertise while helping shape our design practices and product experience as we scale
  • Modern environment: Work with state-of-the-art tools and choose the hardware that works best for you (Mac or Windows)
  • Hybrid working: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely while collaborating regularly with the team in our central Munich office

Du bist unsere erste dedizierte Datenstelle, berichtest an unseren CFO und arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründungsteam, Marketing und Operations. Welcher Kanal bringt Matches statt Downloads.

Du arbeitest dabei AI-First: AI übernimmt die Ausführung, dir gehören Intention, logisches Denken und Korrektheit.

Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 01.10.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Vollzeit 🚀

Aufgaben

Eine Wahrheit, nicht fünf

Du definierst unsere Kernkennzahlen über den gesamten Funnel, einmal verbindlich, mit klarer Namenskonvention und einer Definition pro Metrik. Teile davon existieren bereits, sie sind nur nirgends operationalisiert. Du gleichst die Quellen ab, erklärst Abweichungen und sorgst dafür, dass eine Frage genau eine Antwort hat, egal wer sie stellt.

Den Marktplatz messbar machen

Unsere Analyseeinheit ist der Korridor, nicht die Stadt und nicht das Land. Du machst Angebot, Nachfrage, Fill Rate und Time-to-Match auf dieser Ebene sichtbar, inklusive der Fälle, die in keinem Standard-Funnel auftauchen. Ein Fahrer, der nichts findet, ist bei uns ein Signal, kein fehlender Datenpunkt.

Das MUVN Brain bauen

Heute: direktes SQL, Python-Skripte, API-Pulls. Du überführst das in einen leichtgewichtigen, verbundenen Stack und entscheidest über Architektur und Tools, vom Warehouse über den Transformations-Layer bis zum BI-Tool. Jedes Werkzeug kommt an dem Punkt rein, an dem es seine Kosten verdient, nicht früher. Lieber fünf verlässliche Modelle als fünfzig halb vertraute.

Pipelines, denen man vertraut

Du integrierst unsere Quellen mit Pipelines, die idempotent, testbar und dokumentiert sind. Du baust Validierung zwischen den Quellen und fängst Diskrepanzen ab, bevor sie ein Meeting erreichen. Wenn etwas bricht, findest du die Ursache statt das Symptom und planst Backfills mit Prüfung davor und danach.

Analysen, die Entscheidungen tragen

Wiederkehrendes Management-Reporting, Kohorten, Retention, Pricing, Funnel, Marketing-Performance Ende zu Ende. Ad-hoc-Fragen beantwortest du schnell. Die, die immer wiederkommen, überführst du in Self-Serve-Reports, damit das Team sich selbst bedient.

Das Team unabhängig von dir machen

Du nimmst Anforderungen von Gründern, Marketing und Operations auf und übersetzt sie in Modelle, die wiederverwendbar sind. Du dokumentierst Definitionen, Annahmen und Sonderfälle dort, wo sie hingehören, im Code und in der Doku, nicht in deinem Kopf. Datenfragen sollen nicht bei dir enden.

AI-Agents als Teil des Systems

Du baust und iterierst Agents für klar umrissene Aufgaben: wiederkehrende Reports, Dokumentation, Datenqualitätschecks. Du pflegst die maschinenlesbaren Kontextdateien, die unser Brain überhaupt erst nutzbar machen, mit unseren Konventionen, Definitionen und Domänenregeln. Du prüfst, was AI produziert, bevor es zählt. Die Korrektheit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.

Qualifikation

Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Analyst:in, Analytics Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle und schon einmal ein Reporting von null aufgebaut, nicht nur eines gepflegt. SQL ist für dich Handwerk, nicht Hürde: Window Functions, CTEs, Query-Optimierung, und genug Tiefe, um einen Execution Plan zu lesen und ein Performanceproblem selbst zu finden. Python nutzt du für Analysen und Pipeline-Arbeit.
